description_en: Creates an automatic snapshot policy that enables cloud computers to perform automatic creation of snapshots based on the schedule specified by a Cron expression
description_zh: 创建自动快照策略，让云电脑按照Cron表达式对应的时间自动创建快照
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-name test_auto_policy --retention-days 2 --cron-expression 0_0_2_0_0_1-7 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略的名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。默认值：空
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en: The retention period of automatic snapshots. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 180
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：1\~180
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en: The Cron expression for the scheduled snapshot creation
parameters.help_zh: 时间周期调度的Cron表达式
parameters.name: cron_expression
